When y = 9, x = 6.

(i) the mode of the distribution, 

(ii) the median of the distribution.

Explain clearly, between the mode, mean and median, what would change.

title: Probability with two bags of fruit
body_markdown:
Bag A contains 9 red apples and 3 green apples.
Bag B contains 8 red peaches and 7 yellow peaches.

A fruit is selected at random from each bag.

Find the probability of selecting a green apple.
